description: This source file defines a command named TailLogCommand that tails the most recent log transcripts. It is part of a command-line interface, utilizing the Commander library, and interacts with a TranscriptsStore singleton to retrieve data.

classes.name: TailLogCommand
classes.description: A command-line command that tails recent transcript logs by retrieving the latest entries from TranscriptsStore and printing the last ten lines.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the latest transcripts from TranscriptsStore and prints the last ten lines to the console.
